stem: How did Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr.'s 1963 “I Have a Dream” speech affect U.S. politics?

options.label: F
options.text: By increasing pressure on political leaders to form a new minority-based political party

options.label: G
options.text: By persuading political leaders to introduce literacy tests for voting

options.text: By persuading political leaders to ratify an amendment that extends voting rights to women
